newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea 3-yr bond yields close up on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea 3-yr bond yields close up on profit-taking.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporate bonds closed higher on Friday on profit-taking sparked by recent sharp falls in the yields, dealers said.
But three-month CD yields and the overnight call rate fell as the cash liquidity continued to improve, they said.
* 3-yr corporates close at 12.30 pct vs Thursday's 12.22
* 3-mth CDs end at 13.45 pct vs Thursday's 13.50
* Average overnight call rate at 13.8 pct vs 14.0 pct
